operating_notes.text: Combined installed reactor capacity was 791 KL with 39 assembly lines as of 31 March 2026.
SDA revenue rose to ₹204.5 Cr in FY26 from ₹119.7 Cr in FY25, taking its share of revenue to 41% from 31%.
Exports were 75% of revenue in FY25, per the presentation.
Peak potential revenue from current Dahej facility is estimated around ₹850 crores to ₹900 crores.
Trade receivables rose to ₹178.38 Cr at Sep-2026 from ₹119.03 Cr at Mar-2026.
Inventories rose to ₹248.91 Cr at Sep-2026 from ₹196.07 Cr at Mar-2026.
H1FY27 operating cash flow was negative ₹3.68 Cr against ₹13.38 Cr inflow in H1FY26.
Solvent prices surged 60%-100% due to erratic short supplies during Q2FY27, while global freight costs in US and Europe rose over 100%.
